$schema_note: Documentation index only; this is not a JSON Schema or ingestion API.

domain.provisioning: Hard-coded in OntologyStore.load_defaults; config/domains.yaml is not consumed by ingest.

preview_only_preprocessing.runtime_extraction_note: StructuredExtractor extracts only JSON concept records; Markdown/text chunks do not become entities.

runtime_derivations: ObjectPropertyCandidate or DataPropertyCandidate from relation-name strings
Token-based semantic features and limited hard-coded label cues
Local retrieval/alignment proposals and validation/review states
Approved class type assertions only after ontology version approval
must_not_claim_as_inferred: Business role or identity semantics from labels/fields
Primary keys, foreign keys, cardinality, nullability, domain/range
Trusted authority or customer business rules

gaps: source_system defaults to fixture and input root source_system is ignored
original records/values, record timestamps, ontology source version, and reviewer rationale are not guaranteed

evaluation_only.rule: Never use as normal ingest input or runtime alignment evidence.

infrastructure_not_customer_data.default: Offline deterministic ingest; no LLM/embedding dependency.

application_status.canonical_output: Approved class type assertions in data/outputs/knowledge_graph.ttl after export_kg().
application_status.staging_output: Unapproved class type assertions in data/outputs/staging_knowledge_graph.ttl.
